description: For native formulas \(A,B\) over any atom type with decidable equality, intuitionistic derivability of \(B\) from \(\{A\}\) implies existence of a native \(I\) with both intuitionistic factors \(\{A\}\vdash I\), \(\{I\}\vdash B\), and \(\operatorname{at}(I)\subseteq\operatorname{at}(A)\cap\operatorname{at}(B)\). This is an existential conclusion from Prop-valued native derivability.
